text:
Maya (oncall): Pagerduty alert — multiple customers reporting 5xx and 429s from /v1/generate since ~5400001200. Error rate jumped from ~0.5% to 12% in the last 3m. Routing shows spikes at api-gateway and rl-quota service.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT CREATED • ID INC-2026-540000 — Sev2 — Paging oncall. Initial triage assigned to Maya.
Ethan (platform): seeing a surge of 429s at the quota aggregator. Logs show quota-eval responses returning 500 intermittently. Example: ```2026-03-15T10:00:12Z api-gw ERROR tenant=acme request_id=... upstream=quota-eval status=500 msg="quota eval failed"```
Priya (sre): That matches what I saw on the ingress. Also a bunch of client retries causing a small backpressure loop. 5xx distribution: 502s from gateway and 504s from model-proxy timeouts.
Jonas (support): On the customer front: two enterprise tenants reported degraded response and elevated latency; CS is pinging them. No major data loss, but user-facing errors in prod.
Maya (oncall): immediate plan: 1) put in emergency rate limit soft-fallback to 1rps for noisy tenants, 2) disable the recent quota policy push (if it rolled) — roll back to last known-good, 3) enable router-level fallback to smaller model to reduce model-proxy timeouts. Anyone can run the rollback?
Ethan (platform): I can roll back the quota policy. I see a rollout finished ~5400001100 with tag `quota-policy/v3-traffic`. I will pause the policy and revert to `quota-policy/v2`. Command: ```cli infra policy rollback --name quota-policy --to v2 --reason "emergency 429/5xx cascade"``` Executing now.
incidents-bot: ACTION LOGGED • policy.rollback started by Ethan at 5400001252
Priya (sre): While Ethan rolls that back, I'll throttle the retry window on the gateway to prevent amplification and add a 3s downstream timeout to cut long tails. Patch: ```gateway/config { retry: 1, retry-window-ms: 300, downstream-timeout-ms: 3000 }``` Applying in 2m.
Maya (oncall): Jonas please push a short note to affected customers: "We are investigating increased errors and have applied mitigations; you'll see fewer errors in ~5-10m." Keep updates to 15m cadence.
Jonas (support): On it. Draft: "We're seeing an internal quota configuration issue causing intermittent 429/5xx. Engineers have initiated rollback and gateway mitigations. We'll update in 15 minutes or sooner." Sending now.
Ethan (platform): rollback complete. Confirming quota service reports v2 active and no recent 500s from quota-eval. Observability: quota-eval error rate dropped from 9% -> 0.4% in 2m.
Priya (sre): rolling gateway config now... applied to 3 regions. Adding temporary circuit-breaker on model-proxy: ```model-proxy/circuit-breakers { max-conns: 80, failure-window-s: 30 }```
Maya (oncall): Routing fallback to quantized-small model enabled for best-effort requests. This should reduce per-request latency and cut KV-cache pressure.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE • mitigation: quota policy rolled back, gateway retry reduced, model-proxy CBs added, fallback to small model enabled.
Jonas (support): Customers are reporting immediate improvement — errors dropping. A couple of tenants still see transient 502s but far fewer.
Priya (sre): Monitoring shows 5xx down to 0.9% and 429s to 0.7%. Latency p50 back to normal, p95 improving. I'm going to keep the circuit-breaker and retry-window for another 30m while we watch.
Maya (oncall): Notes for post-incident: - root cause: bad quota policy rollout that caused quota-eval service to hit an unhandled path and respond 500, which cascaded to gateway retries and model-proxy overload. - mitigation: rollback, gateway retry/retry-window changes, model-proxy CB, fallback model routing, customer comms.
Ethan (platform): I'll open a PR to add stronger canary checks for quota policy rollouts (synthetic evals + build-time schema validator) and require gradual ramp with feedback loop.
Jonas (support): Customers acknowledged the update; prepping follow-up email with timeline and RCA ETA.
Maya (oncall): Handing off to Priya for post-mortem and long-running fixes. I'll go clear the pager. Priya take it?
Priya (sre): taking it. I'll coordinate the RCA doc and include remediation tasks: stricter policy validation, rollout throttling, and observability alerts tuned to catch quota-eval 5xx within 1% delta.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED • status changed to monitoring at 5400001395 — follow-ups tracked in INC-2026-540000.
Maya (oncall): Thanks team. Final update in 30m; make sure to file the postmortem and link the PRs. :thumbsup:
